'''I4-K8''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] produced at some point before the [[war against Zakuul]]. By [[3630 BBY]] it was used by renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]] to guard the base they set in the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. When the [[Eternal Alliance]] forces attacked the base, I4-K8 was deployed to stop them, but was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
I4-K8 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the final boss fight of the "Inferno" Uprising.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
